Dear Fellows and Friends!

As previously announced the GO FAIR Family Day will take place on November 26.

To help us organize this event we kindly ask all interested in the Family Day, be it because you want to present something, get a qualification or simply participate, to fill out this [form](https://forms.gle/h6EEPvM2JsTJRxFh8).

We look forward to seeing many of you there and making this Family Day a memorable moment together!
